method: Direct inspection using view_image of all four 38-pose contact sheets, full-resolution tall 50% still, tall preview, 25 samples decoded from the final atlas MP4, and retained airflow hook still.
findings: Policy labels and force disclaimer are readable at full resolution; targets, root/palm axes and both arms are visible.
Peak target positions agree with intended changed stand-off; continuous chapter samples show guard, extension, hold and return, and body descent.
50% target box visibly overlaps the bag. Analytic policy_spatial_audit.json quantifies this as a failed separated-envelope assumption, not a rendering defect.
Retained airflow still shows eight labeled isolated branches and distinct fill/vent cues. Full 128-frame geometry/material equality and byte-identical film were separately checked.
limitations: Contact sheets are thumbnails; full-resolution still used for label readability.
Dark inherited sleeves and reverse-side occlusion limit fine surface inspection.
Decoded samples and complete decode do not establish uninterrupted manual viewing or browser playback.
No force, hardware, loaded-collision or 50% usable opponent-spacing validation.
